; ==== RINGS701.SPF
;M01
R16=chk_pret
CICLA:
INITPART(1)
;DEMO-FRAME

PROFILE

NEXT_L(47.,100.,1,2,3)
G01 G41 X40. Y100.
PROFILE
G01 X40. Y40.
CORNER
G01 X240. Y40.
CORNER
G01 X240. Y160.
CORNER
G01 X40. Y160.
CORNER
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,40.,160.,40.,100.,0,0)
NEXT_L(270.07,100.07,1,2,3)
G01 G41 X265.608 Y98.874
G01 X264.965 Y98.608
G01 X264.413 Y98.184
G01 X263.989 Y97.632
G01 X263.723 Y96.989
G01 X263.632 Y96.298
G01 X263.723 Y95.608
G01 X263.989 Y94.965
G01 X264.413 Y94.413
PROFILE
G01 X265.298 Y93.528
G03 X263.528 Y95.298 I4.702 J6.472
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,263.528,95.298,264.413,94.413,0,0)
NEXT_L(-7.,0.,1,2,3)
G01 G42 X0. Y0.
PROFILE
G01 X300. Y0.
CORNER
G01 X300. Y200.
CORNER
G01 X0. Y200.
CORNER
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,0.,200.,0.,0.,0,0)
ENDGEO
IF R16==1
	  STOPRE
	  R16=0
   GOTOB CICLA
ENDIF
ENDPART
RET
